tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background. Cheek cream in light, dusk slate in dark.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sidebars on surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, hover fills. ink and ink-muted stay ≥4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers (decorative, no contrast requirement).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes): ≥3:1 on surface-000.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface-*.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on surface-000…200 (≥4.7:1).

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Primary: buttons, links, active nav. Crown and wing slate. Text on it: on-slate.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Primary hover / pressed.

tokens.name: slate-100
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info banners, primary tint. ink on top.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on slate-600 / slate-700.

tokens.name: rufous-500
tokens.usage: Accent fills, illustration, charts' second series. Not for body text (3.2:1 in light).

tokens.name: rufous-700
tokens.usage: Accent text, secondary CTA background. Text on it: on-rufous.

tokens.name: rufous-100
tokens.usage: Accent tint: highlights, warm callouts. ink on top.

tokens.name: on-rufous
tokens.usage: Text and icons on rufous-700.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Buff breast tone: illustration and large decorative fields only.

tokens.name: cere
tokens.usage: Signal orange (beak cere, feet): notification dots, 'new' badges. Small areas only, never text.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface-* (≥4.9:1 on surface-200).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, icons, destructive actions on surface-*. Darker than rufous-500 so it is told apart by lightness.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger fills (destructive buttons).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Pattern marks (wing spots) over slate or rufous fills.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and cover titles, one per page.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section rhythm, page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Popovers and modals only. Cards use line, not shadow.
